title: VOOL distributor programme
description: What VOOL offers distributors and wholesalers: the product range, warranty, support, marketing material and how to start.

sections.title: A charging system your installers can sell to whole buildings, not one socket at a time
sections.lead: Charger, load management and software from one maker in Estonia. More than 20,000 devices sold through partners in 15 countries.
sections.alt: VOOL Charger in black, aluminium and wood

items.title: It wins the big jobs
items.text: One LMC Pro manages more than 100 chargers at several fuse levels. That is the argument that wins apartment buildings, offices and car parks.

items.title: One range, few part numbers
items.text: One 22 kW charger in three finishes, on a wall or a pole, with the same controller in every unit. LMC Pro for buildings, LMC S for houses.

items.title: Ready for 2027
items.text: The new charger supports ISO 15118-20, which AFIR requires for chargers installed from 1 January 2027.

items.title: Software with no fixed fee
items.text: The portal is free. Site owners pay only a share of billed sessions, so the software never blocks a hardware sale.

items.title: Few returns
items.text: The charger is modular. A faulty controller is swapped in minutes, without removing the casing or cabling.

items.title: Open protocols
items.text: OCPP, Modbus TCP and OCPI. Your customers are not locked to one operator.
